query: WITH counts AS (SELECT 'exercises' AS item,count(*)::text AS value FROM public.exercises UNION ALL SELECT 'exercise_questions',count(*)::text FROM public.exercise_questions UNION ALL SELECT 'exercise_attempts',count(*)::text FROM public.exercise_attempts UNION ALL SELECT 'exercise_submissions_preserved',count(*)::text FROM public.exercise_submissions), policies AS (SELECT tablename,policyname,cmd,coalesce(qual,'') AS qual,coalesce(with_check,'') AS with_check FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('exercises','exercise_questions','exercise_attempts') ORDER BY tablename,policyname), grants AS (SELECT p.proname,has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE') AS anon_execute,has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE') AS authenticated_execute FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN ('can_access_exercise_for_current_student','get_my_exercise_catalog','get_my_exercise_detail','start_exercise_attempt','submit_exercise_attempt','get_my_exercise_attempt_result','get_my_exercise_history') ORDER BY p.proname), indexes AS (SELECT indexname,indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('exercises','exercise_questions','exercise_attempts') ORDER BY tablename,indexname) SELECT 'count' AS kind,item AS name,value AS details FROM counts UNION ALL SELECT 'policy',tablename || '.' || policyname,cmd || ':' || qual || ':' || with_check FROM policies UNION ALL SELECT 'grant',proname,anon_execute::text || ':' || authenticated_execute::text FROM grants UNION ALL SELECT 'index',indexname,indexdef FROM indexes ORDER BY kind,name LIMIT 100;
